t: Focus up/down wall light crafted from weatherproof aluminium in dark grey. Illuminates with dual-directional lighting that projects above and below to enhance outdoor spaces. Understated architectural design makes it perfect for driveways, garden walls, porches and patios. Blends lasting performance with style and makes installation simple with its fast-fit connector system and oversized back box. Compatible with 2 x GU10 bulbs (maximum 2 x 7W).
